decisions.reason: The black-finish range follows a current bathroom design trend and was launched only in 2023, so weak early uptake can still be put down to market ramp-up, and the firm has already committed to the line by adding it to its range.
The shower channel for seamless coverings has its own page, which shows visible public commitment, and it fits the firm's core drainage direction, so management will persist with it.

The pump-assisted solution is only mentioned, which signals less visible commitment, but the development and certification costs already sunk, together with a construction downturn that can explain slow sales, favour keeping it for now.
The tileable floor drain is presented prominently and is central to the firm's core business, so the investment and public commitment make dropping it unlikely.
The stainless steel design grate has its own page and builds on the firm's metalworking competence, so visible commitment and fit with its announced direction support keeping it.
